business_problem: unify machine, API, ERP, and marketing data on one platform so tesa could detect manufacturing anomalies, simplify customer reporting, and experiment with generative AI without building its own stack.
solution_summary: tesa uses Snowflake and Cortex AI on Snowflake to unify machine, API, ERP, and marketing data on one platform so tesa could detect manufacturing anomalies, simplify customer reporting, and experiment with generative AI without building its own stack. Machine, product, erp, and operational data are centralized in Snowflake so operations and engineering teams can work from a faster, more reliable operating view. Cortex AI adds in-platform LLM and agentic capabilities for classification, summarization, retrieval, or natural-language analytics on top of the curated data foundation. Keeping ingestion, storage, transformation, and governed access on one platform reduces handoffs, simplifies operations, and makes it easier to reuse trusted data across analytics, reporting, and AI. tesa achieved 18 Systems integrated and 10 Terabytes of data managed.
